starting_spirits.label: A Contested Presidential Mandate
starting_spirits.owner: incumbent Park / DRP; reform replaces it
starting_spirits.history: 1969 third-term amendment; Yushin is not yet in force.
starting_spirits.resolution: First DRP constitutional choice replaces this slot; a constitutional opposition settlement removes it.

starting_spirits.label: Concentrated Development Credit
starting_spirits.history: State-directed credit mobilizes industrial capital but concentrates leverage and guarantees.
starting_spirits.resolution: National finance policy replaces this slot. Party credit policies can coexist and show their extra exposure.

starting_spirits.label: The Human Cost of Export Growth
starting_spirits.history: Restricted bargaining, long hours and unsafe workplaces undermine legitimacy and skills.
starting_spirits.resolution: Either national labor policy replaces it: discipline retains a legitimacy malus; compromise sacrifices output.

starting_spirits.label: An Unevenly Developed Republic
starting_spirits.history: Rural infrastructure gaps and rapid urban migration constrain balanced development.
starting_spirits.resolution: Freight corridors improve it to construction -3%, stability -2%; urban services remove the remainder.

starting_spirits.label: An Alliance under Adjustment
starting_spirits.history: The US commitment deters attack while the Nixon Doctrine raises uncertainty and demands local responsibility.
starting_spirits.resolution: An accepted US assurance deal replaces it; strategic autonomy trades defense backing for independence.

starting_spirits.label: Imported Energy, Imported Risk
starting_spirits.history: Rapid industrialization depends on imported fuel and external finance; this is exposure, not a 1973 shock in 1970.
starting_spirits.resolution: Diversified energy planning reduces it; completed and funded existing energy projects remove remaining exposure.

starting_spirits.label: Overseas Employment Programme
starting_spirits.owner: existing starting idea; preserve actual code
starting_spirits.history: Government-organized miners and nurses in West Germany; already granted in KOR country history.
starting_spirits.resolution: Use existing guest-worker contracts and remittance accounting; never grant remittances twice.

starting_spirits.label: Political Officer Networks
starting_spirits.owner: national command problem; active until lawful civilian control
starting_spirits.history: The army, security agencies and private officer networks sustain the developmental state while undermining neutral civilian command.
starting_spirits.resolution: Civilian Appointments plus Constitutional Security remove the command-problem slot. An extra-constitutional rollback restores the unresolved political-command state, not free transition rewards.

starting_spirits.label: Fragmented Social Protection
starting_spirits.history: Coverage remained fragmented and excluded many rural, informal and urban households; broad national coverage was a late 1980s achievement.
starting_spirits.resolution: The funded social-insurance network establishes the new framework and resolves this administrative fragmentation; it does not claim all households were historically insured before 1989.

rules.politics: Exact ruling_party slot plus incumbent leader where required, checked at start AND completion. Coalition membership alone never unlocks an incumbent programme.
rules.lifecycle: Earned national/party/leader slots retained; only active owner contributes. Refresh on government change, load and monthly failsafe. No grant or construction in refresh.
rules.weekly: One unique owner|qualified_policy_slot expense record per focus, replaced by the latest earned level; zero clears that slot. Sum active expense records once plus separate active contract charges; feed COLDWAR_KOR_weekly_cost to native calculate_additional_expense_rate. NEW adapter required.
rules.money: Treasury_change then modify_treasury_effect; billions; paid projects 1–10bn; normal native borrowing; no treasury>=cost gate for domestic expenditure.
rules.buildings: Require owned and controlled intended state and room for the stated building; no silent alternative recipient. Conditions visible. Commit price and grant atomically; a full state prevents the focus from starting/completing.
rules.offers: Offer dispatch is not acceptance. Recipient may accept/refuse. No material agreement bonus or payment before acceptance; finite pending time, both-party revalidation and once-only signature required.
rules.gates: No universal year locks. Actual party office, constitutional settlement, research/project stage, peace and signed agreements supply meaningful gates.
rules.focus_time: Short administrative entries 14/21d, normal programmes 35d; paid construction and major constitutions 49/70d assigned explicitly in final catalogue.
rules.balance: Persistent policies replace owner-qualified slots. Mature cross-sector examples are documented in balance_expansion_review.md; they are not guaranteed national output or solvency. Interest adjustments add percentage points before native clamps. Bureaucracy cost modifiers multiply only the bureaucracy spending category; civilian productivity affects its civilian-industrial tax/GDP component. Weekly commitments add to department costs and one-time capital costs. No hidden aggregate cap is assumed.

anti_duplication: One active signature per contract, recipient pair and term. Offers reached via DRP/RPR/Roh/common tree share the same contract ledger.
Counterpart initiation from NKO resolves the same inter-Korean signature. Simultaneous offers lock to one pending transaction.
A paid focus with an offer stages its displayed budget; where the contract itself carries the same establishment payment it is charged only once on acceptance, not on dispatch as well.
Programme modifiers use owner+qualified policy slot. Completing a later level replaces that slot; it never stacks both levels.
Confederal focus entry AND completion require actual COLDWAR_KOR_confederal_member spirit on both sides; founding offer precedes membership.
Monthly/leadership/load sync recomputes active slot values and weekly costs only. Receipt flags protect all treasury, buildings, experience and PP.

constitutional_process.design: Use native election_allowed/party arrays through the existing politics system, not a parallel cabinet menu. Choices set a persistent national constitutional-settlement flag. Yushin is a new 1970+ decision, never a starting fact; direct election offers no automatic incumbent win.

succession.design: Open native party/leader nomination and office transitions. No forced assassination, predetermined winner, instant outlook reset or population transfer. Conservative merger requires actual coalition/party agreement; changes eligibility and labels through reconciled party registry.

rights.design: Persist legal settlement receipts and replace associated starting/policy spirit slots. Their concrete numerical effects are the focus policies; no hidden free bonus is promised.

contacts.design: Reveal the listed repeatable diplomatic offer decisions (180-day failed-offer cooldown). No material reward from merely opening a list.

energy.design: Link to existing Imperia nuclear/power decisions and special projects. Existing safeguards and research conditions remain; weekly project costs use current COLDWAR_nuclear_development_budget. No free reactor, weapon, uranium deposit, raw production or mine.

workers.design: Link to current overseas-employment/guest-worker agreement flow. The starting idea and shared remittance reader remain the single source of income.

expansion_institutions.design: Implement through transition_system and existing political/economic systems. No label or country flag alone is a judicial, press, command or legitimacy statistic.

transition_links.design: Set an authorized negotiation/commitment receipt. No automatic democracy, leader, referendum result or election-rule grant.

ballot_and_reopening.design: Use transition_decisions and proposed_transition_events. No reset of completed focuses or free model/leader change.

institution_providers.design: Read the exact provider/decision/event table. Dossier opens legal negotiation routes; endorsement uses actual eligible parties; command and ballot events resolve before their receipts are granted.

conditional_review.design: If secretariat or civilian trade signed, reveal joint ratification. Otherwise if conclusively refused/expired, add_political_power = 25; no membership, treaty or unification reward.

party_guarantees.design: Set civilian-party-settlement receipt and keep competitive-party rights in native politics; numerical benefit and cost are the associated focus policy, with no hidden grant.

refusal_routes.mechanism: Native bypass on treaty-only follow-ups after a recorded refusal/expiry; no payout. Common OR joins remain exact. Final Korean settlement conditionally becomes a domestic review.
refusal_routes.graph: 298 focus cards; native bypass is separate from guarded completion rewards.

transition_system.entry_routes: Electoral contest; legitimate caretaker succession; negotiated military withdrawal. Entries are not permanently mutually exclusive: a failed early window may be followed by later talks.
transition_system.military_failure: The command-challenge action sends a real resolution event. Successful civilian command sets negotiating_commitment. Failure sets military_reconsolidation, retains command burden and allows a later authorized military opening. It does not install Chun before a separate actual office transition.

ratification.vote_model: Gameplay abstraction: charter supporters are a unique set of actual party/organization slots. Sum their current native party_pop_array shares divided by the sum of current legal participating shares. Passing requires strictly more than50%; no bonus popularity is created.
ratification.accept: Set constitutional_ratification_passed and exactly one selected constitutional model; call the actual politics/election configuration. No leader is installed by this vote.
ratification.reject: No constitutional programme or election-rule grant. Keep the chosen model; return to negotiation through a repeatable50PP redraft decision after90d. Do not reset focuses or replay rewards.
ratification.model_rejection_rule: Keep the previously chosen model1/2/3. Negotiations may change safeguards/endorsements within that model; resubmit by decision after90d. Changing the model requires a separate constitutional-reversal process, not free focus reset.

conditional.4: Only after a legal revolutionary-party participation settlement
conditional.22: Only an actually formed legal DJP electoral vehicle; an Army institution alone is not a ballot party

eligible_slots.excluded: KCIA7, EPB13 and non-party association slots are not independently counted as ballot parties. Native banned parties are excluded.

ratification.denominator: Sum party_pop_array^s for every currently eligible, non-banned electoral party, whether endorsing or opposing. Endorsement membership is a subset, never the whole denominator by definition.
ratification.supporter_membership: Unique charter_supporter_s flags are set only by accepted, recorded party endorsement. Iterate each eligible slot once; sum its current native popularity only when that receipt is present.
ratification.zero_denominator: Support share remains0 and the vote is rejected/postponed with a data/eligibility diagnostic in the review log. Never divide by zero, fabricate an electorate or grant automatic passage.

transition_system.election: Only the actual native election/coalition result sets lawful_election_completed and installs the corresponding incumbent via the reconciled KOR router. Unity-ticket agreement redistributes existing candidacy/support only; it never ensures victory.
transition_system.national_institutions: Court, press, electoral administration, lawful unions, local-autonomy preparation and civilian appointment rights survive ordinary cabinet change. Their policy effects require the constitutional_order receipt where specified.

rollback.cost: 100PP; stability -10%; requires a resolved coup or a lawful, publicly ratified constitutional reversal
rollback.effect: Disable constitutional_order and safeguards, lawful union/press/command dependent effects; retain earned focus receipts. No institutional bonuses under emergency rule.
rollback.restoration: A public constitutional restoration vote and genuine lawful mandate can restore active earned institutions. No focus reset, cash, factories, experience or one-time PP replay.

transition_system.court_reader: When judicial_review and constitutional_order are active, unlawful emergency/press-ban/security-decree actions are unavailable. A lawful emergency needs the defined Assembly approval and review event; constitutional repeal follows the explicit rollback route. Operational review additionally requires judicial_review_operational, not merely a completed founding focus.
transition_system.civil_command_reader: With civilian_appointments and constitutional_order, the military caretaker/coup entry cannot claim lawful appointment. Its initiator must resolve the actual extra-constitutional challenge and its costs; senior appointment actions require the lawful cabinet authority.
transition_system.labor_provider: If lawful_labour_bargaining is enacted, register labour_unions only if absent, initialize its native state once and call change_labour_unions_opinion with temp_opinion=10. Reconcile IP_idea_configuration so lawful recognition survives ordinary government changes. Never reset existing faction opinion or infer legality from the faction idea alone.
transition_system.historical_dates: Historical milestones remain1971/1972/1979–80/1985/1987/1988–90. Earlier negotiated settlements and parliamentary/consensus constitutions are clearly alternate history. Local elections1991/1995 and Hanahoe dissolution1993 are not historical pre1991 rewards.
